newsitem.title: USA: Graham-Field sees higher Q1 EPS and revs.
newsitem.headline: Graham-Field sees higher Q1 EPS and revs.

text.p: HAUPPAUGE, N.Y., April 24 (Reuter) Graham-Field Health Products Inc said Thursday it expects first quarter earnings to be $0.08 to $0.10 per share on revenues of about $51 million.
In Q1 1995, the company reported net earnings of $.03 per share, excluding a $0.01 a share gain, on revenues of about $27 million.
The healthcare products maker said revenues for 1997 Q1 included revenues of about $11.8 million, representing the company's first full quarter of results for Everest & Jennings.

The company attributed the increase in net earnings to the increase in revenues, an increase in its gross profit margin, and lower selling, general and administrative expenses as a percentage of revenue.
"The company believes that revenues will continue to strengthen throughout the year, and gross profit margins will continue to remain above original expectations," a company statement said.
